# Artifact rejection and decoding in motor imagery EEG

Abstract
We show that automated artifact rejec-
tion improves decoding accuracy in motor imagery EEG
by 4.2 percentage points across 20 subjects.

1 Methods
Epochs were labelled by one expert, whose labels we treat as ground truth for
all comparisons. Signal quality was measured as the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR),
defined as the ratio of evoked power to pre-stimulus baseline power.
Decoding used a CSP + LDA pipeline evaluated with 10-fold cross-validation over trials.

5 Discussion
Our sample was limited to healthy young adults recorded in a single session.
Future studies should test whether the gain holds across sessions and devices.
